span.p:
Blk 8 - FULL attention O(L^2) + MoE
physics bias applied here

div.style: color: rgb(226, 232, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MIXER BUDGET
GatedDeltaNet linear: 20 of 32 blocks
SlidingWindow w=128: 8 of 32 blocks
FULL quadratic: only 4 of 32 blocks
at L=4096: 67M pair evaluations
vs 537M if every block were dense
= 8x cheaper attention term

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
WHY THIS MATCHES RNA
A-form helix is locally periodic and
low-information: linear attention suffices.
Junctions, pseudoknots and kissing loops
need global mixing but are RARE.
The mixer follows the biology.
